_readme: roster / A11 roster example: multiple agents from one config, each a GUID-identified instance with its OWN isolated brain. Each agent's private config volume is bind-mounted at the harness config-home (Claude Code: /root/.claude) and is OPAQUE to Tonoman; auth (the credential store) lands there and persists across restarts. Per agent: omit `guid` to have it assigned + persisted to <state_root>/agents.json; omit `config_volume`/`workspace.root` to derive them from <state_root>/<guid>/{config,memory}. Each agent owns its own bot (telegram.token) so they're reachable side by side. Container provisioning (podman run with the config volume mounted at the config-home, ports namespaced by port_base) is a deploy step. Copy to a git-ignored settings.json and fill the secrets.

agents.name: alpha
agents.role: what this agent is for, in one line — injected each turn so it presents itself by role (roster-name-role)
